title: Create Better Copper
description: returns old copper textures to Create, and changes the new textures to match.
body:
**SUPORTS SIMULATED AND AERONAUTICS**

Reverts all create and minecraft blocks to their create legacy textures, as well as change the following blocks and items to match:

-stock ticker

-stock link

-copper table cover

-transmiter 

it now also supports Create : Enchantment Industry.
